environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed in account 998877665544 under OU ou-abc1-restrictedworkloads. Lambda execution role arn:aws:iam::998877665544:role/UserSearchLambdaRole has identical policies but is subject to IAM permission boundary arn:aws:iam::998877665544:policy/DataAccessBoundary which includes an explicit Deny on rds-data:ExecuteStatement and rds-data:BatchExecuteStatement for any resource when aws:RequestedRegion is not in the approved set AND when the calling service is not the approved internal orchestrator. Additionally, the OU has SCP sid 'DenyDirectRDSNetworkAccess' that denies ec2:CreateNetworkInterface for any principal unless the condition key 'aws:ResourceTag/data-tier' equals 'approved-query-proxy'. The Lambda's VPC configuration references a security group tagged data-tier=lambda-compute (not 'approved-query-proxy'), meaning the function cannot establish network interfaces to reach RDS directly. The function would need to route through an RDS Proxy endpoint which enforces prepared-statement-only mode via its query parsing engine, but the SCP prevents the Lambda from even attaching to the network path required to reach the database.

permission_boundary.condition: unless invoked by approved orchestrator service role
